email.subject1: a signal play for PandaDoc SMB
email.body1:
Sam, saw PandaDoc's AI-native MCP launch and that the native Salesforce CPQ integration is driving 20% more deals closed.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market SMB accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your SMB segment off PandaDoc's hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sam, quick follow-up on the SMB motion.

In SMB the volume math is brutal: the pipeline target usually outpaces what reps can personally cover. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your SMB team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Sam, last bit of proof for your team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SMB reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sam, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling SMB pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running a high-volume SMB motion is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SMB motion? I'll tailor it to your team either way.
